reports.title: Colts Era Lab
reports.publicQuestion: Which Colts front office actually built the best era?
reports.subject: Indianapolis Colts
reports.subtitle: Polian vs. Grigson vs. Ballard
reports.summary: Why the best talent evaluator did not build the best team—and why Polian's advantage was more than Peyton Manning.
reports.fanSummary: Polian built the strongest complete organization. Grigson was better than remembered. Ballard found good players but struggled to turn that talent into sustained winning.
